package main

-- store/store.go --
package store

type DB struct{ Addr string }

//fabrik:provider
func NewDB() *DB { return &DB{Addr: "primary"} }

//fabrik:provider name=replica
func NewReplicaDB() *DB { return &DB{Addr: "replica"} }

type Svc struct{ DB *DB }

//fabrik:inject db name=replica
//fabrik:provider
func NewSvc(db *DB) *Svc { return &Svc{DB: db} }
